# 1 Samuel Chapter 6 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **Book:** 1 Samuel | **Chapter:** 6

---

### Verse 1 — "field" vs. "territory"
- **EMET:** "field" | **LOGOS/PNEUMA:** "territory"
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA uses "territory."

### Verse 6 — "harden" vs. "be stubborn"
- **EMET:** "make heavy your hearts" | **LOGOS:** "harden your hearts" | **PNEUMA:** "be stubborn"
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA uses "harden your hearts" (Exodus vocabulary).

### Verse 7 — cow description
- **EMET:** "nursing ones" | **LOGOS:** "milk cows" | **PNEUMA:** "nursing cows"
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA uses "nursing cows."

### Verse 8 — "box" vs. "chest"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "box" | **PNEUMA:** "chest"
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA uses "chest."

### Verse 9 — "evil" vs. "disaster"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "evil" | **PNEUMA:** "disaster"
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA uses "disaster" (ra'ah as calamity here).

### Verse 18 — Ketiv/Qere: "meadow" vs. "stone"
- **EMET:** "meadow" (Ketiv abel) | **LOGOS/PNEUMA:** "stone" (Qere even)
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows Qere with "stone."

### Verse 19 — number struck
- **EMET:** "seventy men, fifty thousand men" (full MT)
- **LOGOS/PNEUMA:** "seventy men"
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA uses "seventy" — "fifty thousand" is likely textual corruption.

### Verse 20 — "to whom" vs. "where"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "to whom shall He go up from us?"
- **PNEUMA:** "Where can we send Him?"
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows EMET/LOGOS — "to whom" is the Hebrew.

— SOPHIA
